title: Spectre Lens
description: Putting a Spectre Lens on top of a beacon will apply the effects of that beacon to your player no matter where you are in the dimension of the beacon. You can only use 1 Spectre Lens per dimension at once, having multiple ones will make them overwrite each other.

properties.label: Placement
properties.value: Directly on top of a beacon

properties.label: Applies to
properties.value: The player who placed the lens

properties.label: Beacon
properties.value: Needs a complete pyramid (at least level 1)
